# PR comment check: "Enhance embed URL handling and validation system"

The reviewer left 4 issues. 2 are real bugs that need a code change, and 2 are wrong. Verdicts are in `verdicts.json` in the run directory. I didn't change any code. There was no network access, so I didn't look anything up online; the postMessage verdict relies on what I know of the HTML spec.

| # | Category | Verdict | Change code? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Correctness / security | INVALID | No |
| 1 | Correctness | INVALID | No |
| 2 | Correctness | VALID | Yes (low priority) |
| 3 | Correctness | VALID | Yes |

**0. `cook_method` default of 1 means raw HTML: wrong.** Discourse's `Enum` counts from 1 by default (`lib/enum.rb:14-16`). So `:regular` is 1 and `:raw_html` is 2, and the migration default already means `:regular`. Changing it to 0, as suggested, would point at nothing.

**1. postMessage target set to the full referrer URL: wrong.** The HTML spec says the browser parses the target as a URL and uses only its scheme, host and port, so a path doesn't block delivery (`app/views/layouts/embed.html.erb:11`). Separately, the referrer is written into the script without JS-escaping. That's a small cleanup, not what the reviewer flagged.

**2. Missing `require 'open-uri'`: real.** `TopicEmbed.import_remote` calls `open(url)` (`app/models/topic_embed.rb:47`), but only `poll_feed.rb` loads open-uri. That file only gets loaded on this path when feed polling is turned on (`lib/topic_retriever.rb:38-41`). Otherwise the code depends on something else having loaded it first. If nothing has, `open` treats the URL as a local file name and fails. The fix is one line, the same as other files in `lib/` already do.

**3. `i.content.scrub` crashes on nil: real.** The simple-rss gem returns nil for any tag an item doesn't have. Many RSS 2.0 feeds only have `<description>` (or `<content:encoded>`, which the gem exposes under a different name). One such item crashes the hourly job, which is set not to retry (`app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:33`). It also crashes `TopicRetriever`, which runs the job inline. The current tests never run `poll_feed` itself. The fix is to fall back to the other fields and skip items that have no body.

## Next steps
1. Fix #3: add the fallback and skip empty items.
2. Fix #2: add `require 'open-uri'` to `topic_embed.rb`.
3. Reply to #0 and #1 explaining why they don't apply.
